nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field, let $s \in F$ with $s \ne s^{-1}$, and let $M \in \mathrm{SL}_2(F)$ have eigenvalues $s$ and $s^{-1}$, that is, characteristic polynomial $(X - s)(X - s^{-1})$. Then there is $P \in \mathrm{SL}_2(F)$ such that the matrix $P M P^{-1}$ equals the diagonal matrix $\operatorname{diag}(s, s^{-1})$.
nodes.title: Diagonalizing elements of $\mathrm{SL}_2(F)$ with distinct eigenvalues

nodes.summary: Distinct eigenvalues give conjugacy to $\operatorname{diag}(s, s^{-1})$ in $\mathrm{SL}_2(F)$. Let $F$ be a field and let $s \in F$ with $s \ne s^{-1}$ and $s \ne 0$. If $M \in \mathrm{SL}_2(F)$ has eigenvalues $s$ and $s^{-1}$, that is, characteristic polynomial $(X - s)(X - s^{-1})$, then $M$ is conjugate in $\mathrm{SL}_2(F)$ to the diagonal matrix $\operatorname{diag}(s, s^{-1})$.
nodes.title: Distinct eigenvalues give conjugacy to $\operatorname{diag}(s, s^{-1})$ in $\mathrm{SL}_2(F)$

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and let $s \in F$. A matrix $M \in \mathrm{SL}_2(F)$ has eigenvalues $s$ and $s^{-1}$ if its characteristic polynomial is $(X - s)(X - s^{-1})$.
nodes.title: Elements of $\mathrm{SL}_2(F)$ with eigenvalues $s$ and $s^{-1}$

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field, let $s \in F$ with $s \ne 0$, and let $M \in \mathrm{SL}_2(F)$. Then $M$ is conjugate in $\mathrm{SL}_2(F)$ to the diagonal matrix $\operatorname{diag}(s, s^{-1})$ if and only if there is $P \in \mathrm{SL}_2(F)$ such that the matrix $P M P^{-1}$ equals $\operatorname{diag}(s, s^{-1})$.
nodes.title: Conjugacy to $\operatorname{diag}(s, s^{-1})$ in terms of a conjugator

nodes.summary: Matrices with the same distinct eigenvalues lie in the same normal subgroups of $\mathrm{SL}_2(F)$. Let $F$ be a field, let $N$ be a normal subgroup of $\mathrm{SL}_2(F)$, and let $s \in F$ with $s \ne s^{-1}$. If $N$ contains a matrix with eigenvalues $s$ and $s^{-1}$, then $N$ contains every matrix in $\mathrm{SL}_2(F)$ with eigenvalues $s$ and $s^{-1}$.
nodes.title: Matrices with the same distinct eigenvalues lie in the same normal subgroups of $\mathrm{SL}_2(F)$
